“有一天我觉得无聊，就把所有东西都放在百吉饼上。”

Everything Everywhere All At Once（以前称为 E-Z All-Inclusive）是一个包罗万象的 txt2img 工作流程。别担心，它是有机的– 无需自定义节点。其中包含指南，如果您不熟悉，请下载最新版本，然后单击旧版本以获取界面的视觉示例。这是我用于 txt2img 的工作流程，我喜欢它。

EEAAO 具有在宇宙之间切换的开关：
- 随机种子输出
- 一粒种子的 CFG 变化
- 四种不同的高档变体和一个快速高档精炼机
- SDXL 或 SD 1.5
- 3 个 LoRA 和 1 个 SDXL ControlNet
- 吸进 ♫ 到 ♫ 百吉饼 ♫

我将正面和负面提示分开，以利用 SDXL 的 CLIP G，它比旧的 CLIP L 更具动态性。我仍然使用 CLIP L 来增强提示中的某些单词，例如摄像机角度和灯光，但输入的内容越多，输出的变化就越少。如果您真的很难获得想要的东西，请在两个部分中输入相同的提示，但请注意，CLIP L 增强确实限制了您从 CLIP G 获得的一些多样性。

SDXL ControlNet 型号（如果您想使用 ControlNet，则需要）：

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/tree/main/control-LoRAs-rank256

自定义节点管理器（非必需）：

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

o.en:
"I got bored one day and put everything on a bagel."

Everything Everywhere All At Once (formerly E-Z All-Inclusive) is an encompassing txt2img workflow.Don't worry, it's organic– no custom nodes needed. A guide is included, and if you're new to this, download the latest version and then click on older versions for visual examples of the interface. This is the workflow I use for txt2img, and I love it.

EEAAO has toggles to switch between universes:
- random seed output
- CFG variations of one seed
- four different upscale variations and a quick upscale refiner
- SDXL or SD 1.5
- 3 LoRAs and 1 SDXL ControlNet
- Sucked ♫ into ♫ a bagel ♫

I split the positive and negative prompts to utilize SDXL's CLIP G, which is far more dynamic than the old CLIP L. I still use CLIP L to boost certain words in a prompt, like camera angles and lighting, but the more you put in there, the less variety you'll get in outputs. If you're really struggling to get what you want, put the same prompt in both sections, but be advised that the CLIP L boost really limits some of the variety you get from CLIP G.

SDXL ControlNet models (required if you want to use ControlNet):

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/control-lora/tree/main/control-LoRAs-rank256

Custom node manager (not required):

https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager
